attacks.name: Electric Blast
steps: After each attack is resolved, this character gains 1 |!power|.
|!wild| |*Shock|: After each attack is resolved, the target character gains the |§shock§Shock| special condition.

attacks.name: Homing Rockets
steps: This attack ignores LOS, and the defending character does not benefit from cover.
|!wild| |*Explosive|: Before |!damage| is dealt, other enemy characters within |!range| 2 of the target character suffer 1 |!damage|.

superPowers.name: Unbreakable Red Line (Affiliation: Winter Guard)
superPowers.body: At the start of an allied character's activation it may remove 1 special condition.|\|When an allied character is contesting a Secure objective and would be pushed, it may roll a die. On a |!critical|, |!wild|, or |!block| result, it is not pushed.

superPowers.name: Propulsion Thrusters
superPowers.body: Place this character within |!range| 2 of its current position. This superpower can be used only once per turn.

superPowers.name: Disruption Field
superPowers.body: When this character or another allied character is targeted by an enemy attack and the enemy is within |!range| 3 of this character it may use this superpower. This character may reroll up to 2 of the attacker's dice.

superPowers.name: Carborundum Matrix Alloy
superPowers.body: When this character would suffer |!damage| from an enemy effect, reduce the amount suffered by 1, to a minimum of 1.
